The '''Kashyyyk Life Day Choir''' was a [[choir]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that performed [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] music. It was mentioned by [[Gault Rennow]] when he threatened [[Dretcher]] while trying to make him leave his hideout container.<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
